text: {"name":"rf_ana_power_cal_list_init","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Initializes RF analog-power calibration selection state from mask bits 20–27 and records selected indices in the supported 8–15 range.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"a1":"calibration_mask","a2":"calibration_state","v5":"mask_bit_position","v6":"ana_power_index"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":40,"meaning":"Start of the selected analog-power calibration index list."},{"offset":56,"meaning":"Count of accepted indices and insertion index for the list."},{"offset":60,"meaning":"Index state initialized to 15 and updated as calibration indices are accepted."},{"offset":64,"meaning":"Index state initialized to 8 and conditionally updated for a low-range candidate."}]}
